name: manual_190cd1
claim: Tests that touch a default well-known port collide with the real service on the development machine: a test of the front end step saw the real listener on 8443 and reported already listening. Use a free port or an explicit setting in every test that touches a default port.

decisions.notes: One new test failed only because the real front end was running; passing a free port isolated it.

rationale: One new test failed only because the real front end was running; passing a free port isolated it.
